1.name: Finding Joy in the Pain
1.ov: After enjoying some precious family time in Murcia, Carlos Alcaraz faces the stress of an injury as his participation in Roland-Garros is on the line.

1.name: I'm Not Rafa
1.ov: The team remembers Carlos' early days before his first Grand Slam. As he prioritizes fun and well-being, doubts arise about a lasting, successful career.

1.name: My Way
1.ov: The pressure to win weighs on a burned-out Carlos after the Olympics. His circle tries to uplift him as Rafael Nadal's retirement ceremony approaches.
